item.title: 40 rooms available at subsidised rates in Lodi
item.description: The Barnabite Congregation "Provincia Lombarda dei Chierici Regolari di San Paolo detti Barnabiti" offers 40 single rooms at subsidised rates in its Lodi Student Residence.%0AFor information on eligibility requirements and how to apply, see the call for applications.%0A%0A📄 Lodi Student Residence call for applications

item.title: Call for volunteers at BookCity, 23-28 November 2026
item.description: The University is looking for volunteers to help during the book and reading festival BookCity Milano, for the events that will take place on campus from 23 to 28 November 2026. The application deadline is 13 November 2026.%0A%0A▶️ Learn more on Unimi.it

item.title: SLAM webinar “Lingue straniere e dislessia: i Disturbi Specifici di Apprendimento raccontati agli insegnanti di lingua”, 11 novembre 2026, alle ore 15.00
item.description: Sono aperte le iscrizioni al WEBINAR organizzato dal Centro Linguistico d’Ateneo SLAM dal titolo “Lingue straniere e dislessia: i Disturbi Specifici di Apprendimento raccontati agli insegnanti di lingua”. tenuto dalla dott.ssa Anna Maria Mandelli e previsto in data 11 novembre 2026, alle ore 15.00.%0A%0A▶️ Learn more on Unimi.it

item.title: Upcoming strike
item.description: On Friday, 30 October 2026, there may be service disruptions due to a strike. This will not affect the following services: final exams for Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees, postgraduate schools and PhD programmes, issuing of urgent certificates.%0A

item.title: New deadline for enrolment
item.description: For a number of undergraduate programmes, the enrolment deadline has been extended and enrolment is still possible. The TOLC test required for admission must be taken at least 48 hours before the enrolment deadline. %0AFor more information, please read the extension notice.%0A%0A📄 Extension of the enrolment deadline for undergraduate programmes A.Y. 2026-2027

item.title: Dual Career programme for student-athletes
item.description: The Dual Career programme is an initiative aimed at supporting high-level athletes in balancing their competitive sports commitments with their university career.%0A%0A▶️ Learn more on Unimi.it
